title: एकोनविंशतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Seeing Pradyumna fall, the Vrishnis lose heart, and his charioteer, Daruka's son, drives him from the field. Reviving, Pradyumna rebukes him bitterly for shaming him by retreat and orders him back into battle.
summary.kn: ಪ್ರದ್ಯುಮ್ನನು ಬಿದ್ದುದನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ವೃಷ್ಣಿಗಳು ಧೈರ್ಯಗೆಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಸಾರಥಿ ದಾರುಕಪುತ್ರನು ಅವನನ್ನು ರಣರಂಗದಿಂದ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಎಚ್ಚರಗೊಂಡ ಪ್ರದ್ಯುಮ್ನನು ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿದು ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಅವಮಾನಿಸಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಅವನನ್ನು ತೀವ್ರವಾಗಿ ಗದರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ನಡೆಸೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: प्रद्युम्न को गिरते देख वृष्णि हताश होते हैं, और उनका सारथी, दारुक-पुत्र, उन्हें रणभूमि से बाहर ले जाता है। होश में आकर प्रद्युम्न पीछे हटकर उन्हें लज्जित करने के लिए उसे कड़ी फटकार लगाते हैं और फिर युद्ध में चलने का आदेश देते हैं।
summary.te: ప్రద్యుమ్నుడు పడిపోవడం చూసి వృష్ణులు నిరుత్సాహపడతారు, సారథి దారుకపుత్రుడు అతనిని రణరంగం నుండి బయటకు తీసుకువెళ్తాడు. స్పృహలోకి వచ్చిన ప్రద్యుమ్నుడు వెనుదిరిగి తనను అవమానించినందుకు అతనిని తీవ్రంగా మందలించి మళ్లీ యుద్ధానికి నడపమంటాడు.
summary.ta: ப்ரத்யும்னன் விழுந்ததைக் கண்டு வ்ருஷ்ணிகள் மனம் தளர, அவன் தேரோட்டி தாருகனின் மகன் அவனைக் களத்திலிருந்து வெளியே கொண்டு செல்கிறான். மயக்கம் தெளிந்த ப்ரத்யும்னன், பின்வாங்கித் தன்னை இழிவுபடுத்தியதற்காக அவனைக் கடுமையாகக் கடிந்து மீண்டும் போருக்குச் செலுத்தச் சொல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: പ്രദ്യുമ്നൻ വീഴുന്നത് കണ്ട് വൃഷ്ണികൾ നിരാശരാകുന്നു; ദാരുകന്റെ മകനായ സാരഥി അദ്ദേഹത്തെ യുദ്ധക്കളത്തിൽനിന്ന് മാറ്റുന്നു. ബോധം തിരിച്ചുകിട്ടിയ പ്രദ്യുമ്നൻ, പിന്മാറി തന്നെ അപമാനിച്ചതിന് സാരഥിയെ കഠിനമായി ശാസിക്കുകയും യുദ്ധത്തിലേക്ക് മടക്കിക്കൊണ്ടുപോകാൻ കൽപ്പിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.19; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
शाल्वबाणार्दिते तस्मिन्प्रद्युम्ने बलिनां वरे ।
वृष्णयो भग्नसंकल्पा विव्यथुः पृतनागताः ॥

meaning.en: When Pradyumna, best of the strong, was struck by Shalva's arrows, the Vrishnis in the army lost heart and trembled.

verses.text:
हाहाकृतमभूत्सार्वं वृष्ण्यन्धकबलं तदा ।
प्रद्युम्ने पतिते राजन्परे च मुदिताभवन् ॥

meaning.en: The whole Vrishni and Andhaka force cried out in alarm; when Pradyumna fell, king, their enemies rejoiced.

verses.text:
तं तथा मोहितं दृष्ट्वा सारथिर्जवनैर्हयैः ।
रणादपाहरत्तूर्णं शिक्षितो दारुकिस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him so stunned, his charioteer, Daruka's trained son, quickly drew the chariot away from battle with swift horses.

verses.text:
नातिदूरापयाते तु रथे रथवरप्रणुत् ।
धनुर्गृहीत्वा यन्तारं लब्धसंज्ञोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥

meaning.en: When the chariot had gone not far, Pradyumna, crusher of enemy chariots, regained his senses, took his bow and said this to the driver.

verses.text:
सौते किं ते व्यवसितं कस्माद्यासि पराङ्मुखः ।
नैष वृष्णिप्रवीराणामाहवे धर्म उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Charioteer, what have you decided? Why do you go with your back to the foe? This is not called the way of Vrishni heroes in battle.

verses.text:
कच्चित्सौते न ते मोहः शाल्वं दृष्ट्वा महाहवे ।
विषादो वा रणं दृष्ट्वा ब्रूहि मे त्वं यथातथम् ॥

meaning.en: Charioteer, are you not confused at the sight of Shalva in the great battle, or dismayed at seeing the fight? Tell me truly.

verses.text: सूत उवाच

meaning.en: The charioteer said:

verses.text:
जानार्दने न मे मोहो नापि मे भयमाविशत् ।
अतिभारं तु ते मन्ये शाल्वं केशवनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Janardana, I am not confused and fear has not entered me. But I think Shalva is too heavy a burden for you, joy of Keshava.

verses.text:
सोऽपयामि शनैर्वीर बलवानेष पापकृत् ।
मोहितश्च रणे शूरो रक्ष्यः सारथिना रथी ॥

meaning.en: So I retreat slowly, hero; this sinner is strong, and a warrior who is stunned in battle should be protected by his charioteer.

verses.text:
आयुष्मंस्त्वं मया नित्यं रक्षितव्यस्त्वयाप्यहम् ।
रक्षितव्यो रथी नित्यमिति कृत्वापयाम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Long-lived one, you must always be protected by me, and I by you; thinking that the chariot-warrior must always be protected, I am retreating.

verses.text:
एकश्चासि महाबाहो बहवश्चापि दानवाः ।
नसमं रौक्मिणेयाहं रणं मत्वापयाम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: You are alone, mighty-armed one, and the Danavas are many. Son of Rukmini, I do not think this fight an equal one, so I retreat.

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
एवं ब्रुवति सूते तु तदा मकरकेतुमान् ।
उवाच सूतं कौरव्य निवर्तय रथं पुनः ॥

meaning.en: As the charioteer spoke so, the one with the makara banner said to him, descendant of Kuru, "Turn the chariot back again."

verses.text:
दारुकात्मज मैवं त्वं पुनः कार्षीः कथंचन ।
व्यपयानं रणात्सौते जीवतो मम कर्हिचित् ॥

meaning.en: Son of Daruka, never do this again: never leave the battle while I live, charioteer.

verses.text:
न स वृष्णिकुले जातो यो वै त्यजति संगरम् ।
यो वा निपतितं हन्ति तवास्मीति च वादिनम् ॥

meaning.en: He is not born in the Vrishni line who abandons the fight, or who kills one fallen who says "I am yours."

verses.text:
तथा स्त्रियं वै यो हन्ति वृद्धं बालं तथैव च ।
विरथं विप्रकीर्णं च भग्नशस्त्रायुधं तथा ॥

meaning.en: Nor one who kills a woman, an old man or a child, or one without a chariot, scattered, or with broken weapons.

verses.text:
त्वं च सूतकुले जातो विनीतः सूतकर्मणि ।
धर्मज्ञश्चासि वृष्णीनामाहवेष्वपि दारुके ॥

meaning.en: You were born in the family of charioteers, trained in a charioteer's work, Daruka's son, and you know the dharma of the Vrishnis, even in battles.

verses.text:
स जानंश्चरितं कृत्स्नं वृष्णीनां पृतनामुखे ।
अपयानं पुनः सौते मैवं कार्षीः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the whole conduct of the Vrishnis at the head of an army, charioteer, never retreat again.

verses.text:
अपयातं हतं पृष्ठे भीतं रणपलायिनम् ।
गदाग्रजो दुराधर्षः किं मां वक्ष्यति माधवः ॥

meaning.en: What will invincible Gadagraja, Madhava, say to me, fled, struck in the back, afraid, running from battle?

verses.text:
केशवस्याग्रजो वापि नीलवासा मदोत्कटः ।
किं वक्ष्यति महाबाहुर्बलदेवः समागतः ॥

meaning.en: What will the mighty-armed Baladeva, elder brother of Keshava, in blue garments and wild with pride, say when he arrives?

verses.text:
किं वक्ष्यति शिनेर्नप्ता नरसिंहो महाधनुः ।
अपयातं रणात्सौते साम्बश्च समितिंजयः ॥

meaning.en: What will the great-bowed tiger-man, Shini's grandson Satyaki, say, charioteer, of my fleeing the battle? What will Samba, victor in assemblies, say?

verses.text:
चारुदेष्णश्च दुर्धर्षस्तथैव गदसारणौ ।
अक्रूरश्च महाबाहुः किं मां वक्ष्यति सारथे ॥

meaning.en: What will unassailable Charudeshna, Gada and Sarana, and mighty-armed Akrura say to me, charioteer?

verses.text:
शूरं संभावितं सन्तं नित्यं पुरुषमानिनम् ।
स्त्रियश्च वृष्णीवीराणां किं मां वक्ष्यन्ति संगताः ॥

meaning.en: What will the wives of the Vrishni heroes, gathered together, say of me, a man always known as brave and regarded as proud of his manhood?

verses.text:
प्रद्युम्नोऽयमुपायाति भीतस्त्यक्त्वा महाहवम् ।
धिगेनमिति वक्ष्यन्ति न तु वक्ष्यन्ति साध्विति ॥

meaning.en: They will say: here comes Pradyumna, afraid, having left the great battle; they will say "Shame on him," not "Well done."

verses.text:
धिग्वाचा परिहासोऽपि मम वा मद्विधस्य वा ।
मृत्युनाभ्यधिकः सौते स त्वं मा व्यपयाः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: A reproach of "Shame!", even in jest, for me or one like me, is worse than death, charioteer; so do not run away again.

verses.text:
भारं हि मयि संन्यस्य यातो मधुनिहा हरिः ।
यज्ञं भरतसिंहस्य पार्थस्यामिततेजसः ॥

meaning.en: Madhu's slayer Hari has gone, leaving the burden to me, to the sacrifice of Pritha's son, the tiger of the Bharatas, of boundless splendor.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा मया वीरो निर्यास्यन्नेव वारितः ।
शाल्वं निवारयिष्येऽहं तिष्ठ त्वमिति सूतज ॥

meaning.en: Heroic Kritavarman was held back by me as he was about to go out: I told him, "Stay, charioteer's son; I will hold off Shalva."

verses.text:
स च संभावयन्मां वै निवृत्तो हृदिकात्मजः ।
तं समेत्य रणं त्यक्त्वा किं वक्ष्यामि महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: And Hridika's son, honoring me, turned back. Having met him after quitting the fight, what shall I tell that great chariot-warrior?

verses.text:
उपयातं दुराधर्षं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् ।
पुरुषं पुण्डरीकाक्षं किं वक्ष्यामि महाभुजम् ॥

meaning.en: What shall I tell the invincible lotus-eyed Person, the mighty-armed bearer of conch, discus and mace, when he comes?

verses.text:
सात्यकिं बलदेवं च ये चान्येऽन्धकवृष्णयः ।
मया स्पर्धन्ति सततं किं नु वक्ष्यामि तानहम् ॥

meaning.en: What shall I say to Satyaki, to Baladeva and to the other Andhakas and Vrishnis who always vie with me?

verses.text:
त्यक्त्वा रणमिमं सौते पृष्ठतोऽभ्याहतः शरैः ।
त्वयापनीतो विवशो न जीवेयं कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: If I abandon this fight, charioteer, struck in the back by arrows and carried away helpless by you, I could not live at all.

verses.text:
स निवर्त रथेनाशु पुनर्दारुकनन्दन ।
न चैतदेवं कर्तव्यमथापत्सु कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: So turn back at once with the chariot, Daruka's son; never do this in a time of danger.

verses.text:
न जीवितमहं सौते बहु मन्ये कदाचन ।
अपयातो रणाद्भीतः पृष्ठतोऽभ्याहतः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: I never value life much, charioteer, if I were to leave the battle afraid and be struck by arrows in the back.

verses.text:
कदा वा सूतपुत्र त्वं जानीषे मां भयार्दितम् ।
अपयातं रणं हित्वा यथा कापुरुषं तथा ॥

meaning.en: When, son of a charioteer, have you ever known me afflicted with fear, having left the field like a coward?

verses.text:
न युक्तं भवता त्यक्तुं संग्रामं दारुकात्मज ।
मयि युद्धार्थिनि भृशं स त्वं याहि यतो रणम् ॥

meaning.en: It is not fitting for you, son of Daruka, to abandon the battle while I am so eager to fight. So go where the battle is.
